notes.title: Space Hole 2018: 2023 Edition!
notes.content:
[p]Space Hole 2018: 2023 Edition!
Space Hole 2018 v2.0 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32880984/af9851070ee0d0f9d14cc276c448ff4e489bfe05.png"][/img]This is the largest set of changes to Space Hole 2018 since the 1.0 patch in 2019.  Some of these changes incorporate learnings and techniques from my upcoming game, EXTREME EVOLUTION: drive to divinity, which itself is a spiritual successor to Space Hole 2018!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32880984/fbe60844d8743aa43f9a5ae88aa7daab820316ae.png"][/img]Major new things:

 New pause menu (start on controller or Esc on keyboard), featuring a list of the aspects you've unlocked & their default key binding, the total number of space gems you've collected, and control/UI options. Control remapping & graphics settings remain in the pre-game launcher.
 Ending (where you get the Very Far achievement) reworked.
 Warp reworked (levels now have shiny borders, perspective is angled down). 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32880984/b25112aef04e219835e78bb89ad424653e63501b.png"][/img] View overall Space map from the pause menu of Warp.
 New progression tracking in pause menu (grow the space gem cluster!)
 New objective marker & new zone indication text. Objectives such as space gems, aspects, and holes are now marked with icons.  Note a different icon is used for ball holes and ball/ship holes!  New aspects in Lab will be labeled with a '?'
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32880984/bb5a5cedde197091aeda2ebbfa52276e8b4988d5.png"][/img] New toggleable options to disable popup UI messages (such as the respawn reminder and the All Clear text)  Deep3c (a level in Deep Space) performance fix (this is the purple level with too many particles and a small swervy track)  Slow-mo effect when you pickup space gems  Faster loading, especially the main menu from the photosensitivity warning  Delete your save from the main menu pause menu [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32880984/48c3efde211a0067fa6d44e9caaf271e53c295fd.png"][/img]

[/p]

notes.title: It's (almost) time for Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity
notes.content:
The spiritual successor to Space Hole 2018 is now announced! If you enjoy Space Hole (especially 2018) you'll love Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity.

This new game is a lot larger than any I've made before, and will be another collaboration with DL Salo's music! It's about biological transformation.  Follow the steam page below or the join [url=https://discord.gg/MB2kvpX5um]the space hole discord[/url] for all the updates!

[previewyoutube=PsbOYvs7l_g;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111360/Extreme_Evolution_Drive_to_Divinity/

notes.title: Space Hole 2018 1.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Today I'm launching Space Hole 2018 into full release!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=deznXAjqvWk

Over the course of early access, I've tweaked and fixed a lot of things, including:
[list]
[*] New graphical effects throughout the game
[*] New "experimental" experiences/toys
[*] New secrets
[*] Tons of bug fixes
[*] Sound effects adjustments
[/list]


Thanks,
Sam Atlas

notes.title: V1 on January 23rd
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I made a new trailer! Check it out here https://youtu.be/deznXAjqvWk :) 

The v1 (ending early access) for Space Hole 2018 is going to happen on January 23 2019.

This update will bring bug fixes, graphical improvements, and more secrets/polish!

Thanks for playing everyone!


Thanks,
Sam

notes.title: Space Hole 2018: Patch 5
notes.content:

Thanks!

notes.title: Space Hole 2018: Lounge (v1) Update! (Patch 4)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This patch adds:

* [b]New Feature:[/b] experimental "Lounge" mode to main menu https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XpN4K-RpzCg

* Bug fixes to enable camera modes (F1-F4) in more levels in Fungal Expansion
* Added Scroll Lock hotkey to disable/enable mouse lock (to make the game more compatible with Mhook)

Thanks!
-Sam Atlas

notes.title: Space Hole Patch 3

notes.title: Space Hole 2018 Update 2
notes.content:

Have fun!
-Sam Atlas
